title: Shannon fall, Quercus Point and Squamish city Private tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Our journey will begin from the center of Vancouver to Squamish itself, along the way you can enjoy not only the scenery but also a beautiful road such as the Sea to Sky Highway. You will have panoramic views of the Pacific Ocean and a network of islands to the left and rugged mountain peaks to the right. The road follows the rugged coastline, passing picturesque coves, rocky cliffs and sandy beaches. You'll see local activities such as sea kayaking, sailing and beach walks. Continuing your journey, you will come across several picturesque viewpoints and waterfalls such as Shanon falls, Quercus point, Mamquam falls, Squamish cite where you can stop and admire the natural beauty of the region.
